cases.name: forward-skip
cases.body:
var x=1
goto skip
x=2
skip:
return x
cases.cs: int x=1; goto skip; skip: return x;

cases.name: in-order-assignments
cases.body:
var x=0
x=1
goto after
x=99
after:
x+=10
return x
cases.cs: int x=0; x=1; goto after; after: x+=10; return x;

cases.name: backward-loop
cases.body:
var x=0
top:
x+=1
if(x<5){goto top}
return x
cases.cs: int x=0; top: x+=1; if(x<5){goto top;} return x;

cases.name: goto-from-nested-block
cases.body:
var x=0
{
x=7
goto done
}
done:
return x
cases.cs: int x=0; {x=7; goto done;} done: return x;

cases.name: assigned-before-jump
cases.body:
var x=5
goto skip
x=1
skip:
return x
cases.cs: int x=5; goto skip; skip: return x;

cases.name: label-fallthrough-and-goto
cases.body:
var x=1
if(x==1){goto join}
join:
return x+1
cases.cs: int x=1; if(x==1){goto join;} join: return x+1;

cases.name: multiple-labels
cases.body:
var x=0
goto one
two:
x+=10
return x
one:
x+=1
goto two
cases.cs: int x=0; goto one; two: x+=10; return x; one: x+=1; goto two;

cases.name: label-in-if-branch-backward
cases.cs: int x=0; while(true){x+=1;if(x==3){goto finish;}} finish: return x;

cases.name: goto-skip-nested
cases.body:
var x=0
if(true){x=1
goto outside
x=2}
outside:
return x
cases.cs: int x=0; if(true){x=1;goto outside;} outside: return x;

cases.name: label-after-declaration
cases.body:
var x:int
goto assign
assign:
x=4
return x
cases.cs: int x; goto assign; assign: x=4; return x;

cases.name: forward-label-earlier-goto
cases.body:
var x=0
goto first
first:
x=2
goto second
second:
x+=3
return x
cases.cs: int x=0; goto first; first: x=2; goto second; second: x+=3; return x;

negative.name: read-before-assignment
negative.body:
var x:int
goto skip
x=1
skip:
return @@x

negative.name: skip-local-declaration
negative.body:
var x=1
goto done
var y=2
@@done:
return x
